title: China’s mathematicians form an AI alliance as Western debate deepens
teaser: Western mathematicians are debating whether AI-generated proofs weaken understanding or simply flood the field with claims to check. In China, mathematician Shing-Tung Yau and a group of leading Chinese mathematicians have formed an alliance across eight institutions, aiming to build a network of more than 1,000 researchers. The contrast is not just about whether to use AI: the alliance plans to develop specialized models, produce proofs that can be checked automatically and make AI reasoning transparent, even as Yau warns that China is behind the United States.
